findings.baseline: A retained medium rating maps to needs-decision-first, so an autonomous run gives it a resolve-attempt; a resolve-attempt that fails invokes the shared Park protocol.
findings.candidate: Medium maps to needs-decision-first. An autonomous resolve-attempt that fails invokes Park protocol.
findings.loss: The positive obligation to perform the resolve-attempt is omitted; conditional failure handling alone does not require attempting resolution.
findings.minimal_correction: State that an autonomous run gives it a resolve-attempt, then retain existing failure, label, cause and no-merely-surfaced instructions.
